Answer.description: The browser's answer to a ceremony: WebAuthn JSON, checked by the library.
Answer.title: Answer

CardioActivity.description: What a logged cardio session was (ux-flow-plan A1). Optional on a workout.
CardioActivity.title: CardioActivity

ClashReply.description:
The person's answer to a clash: ``replace``, ``add`` or ``move:YYYY-MM-DD``, with the ids
of the workouts they were shown. Left out on the first try.
ClashReply.title: ClashReply

ClashView.description:
What is already saved for ``day``. ``moving``: it is the day the old workout would have
moved to, which holds a session too: pick another day.
ClashView.title: ClashView

DailyCheckView.description: Today's check: the questions, and the answers with their advice once given.
DailyCheckView.title: DailyCheckView

DoneView.description:
A confirmed set; ``right`` only for one-sided exercises (empty: same as left).
``started_at`` and ``done_at``: when the set's screen appeared and when it was confirmed,
from the phone's clock (ADR-0061); kept only when both are there and plausible.
DoneView.title: DoneView

Evidence.description: How well a muscle's own band is supported; the app marks the weak ones.
Evidence.title: Evidence

HealthView.description: Everything empty until band data arrives.
HealthView.title: HealthView

IngestReceived.description:
How many records of each type were stored, and skipped as not fitting. A press of the
app's Test button also gets ``test`` and a ``note`` saying nothing was stored, so its log
shows it; a real sync gets neither.
IngestReceived.title: IngestReceived

LogOptionsView.description:
What a log can be: every session, and what cardio was. The days are today back to 14
days ago (``domain.dates.MAX_DAYS_BACK``); the browser lists them, the save checks them.
LogOptionsView.title: LogOptionsView

MoveView.description: One movement of the guided mobility flow (ADR-0062).
MoveView.title: MoveView

OptionsView.description:
``planned`` is today's session when it is a single cardio exercise: "Done as planned"
saves its target in one tap. Any other cardio is logged as an extra.
OptionsView.title: OptionsView

Pace.description: How big a step each set aims for (ADR-0057). A per-person setting.
Pace.title: Pace

ProposalSave.description: The token, and the answer when the day already has its session (ADR-0060).
ProposalSave.title: ProposalSave

ReadinessView.description: The questions, the latest answers if they still count, and what they mean.
ReadinessView.title: ReadinessView

Refusal.description:
Why a sync that carried a known secret stored nothing, kept so Account can show it. A
wrong secret or a rate limit comes before the secret is known, so isn't kept: it could be
anyone's.
Refusal.title: Refusal

SessionTimeView.description: A session's times in whole minutes, from its timed guided sessions (ADR-0061).
SessionTimeView.title: SessionTimeView

Sound.description: What a guided timer plays at each change (ADR-0062). A per-person setting.
Sound.title: Sound

TimingView.description:
How long a timed session took, in whole minutes (ADR-0061): ``minutes`` is its sets and
the rests between them; breaks (gaps over 10 minutes) are counted apart.
TimingView.title: TimingView

TodayView.description:
``session`` is empty when nothing planned is left today (done or rested); ``progress``
is where the person left off, to resume.
TodayView.title: TodayView

UndoView.description: What Undo would take back, or why nothing can be.
UndoView.title: UndoView

get.description:
RFC 8414. Public clients only (``none``), PKCE S256 only, registration open but bounded.
No client ID metadata documents: Claude then registers (its documented fallback).
RFC 9728: what ``/mcp`` is and which server issues its tokens.
The same, at the path RFC 9728 derives from the ``/mcp`` URL.

My training as compact Markdown for my own AI (ADR-0047): the last 4 or 12 weeks, or
everything. Measurements and readiness answers (health data) only when asked for; photos
never.

delete.description:
Remove the key. No fresh sign-in (removing sends nothing anywhere), but alerted, so a
removal from a stolen session doesn't go unnoticed.

put.description:
Check the key with Groq, then keep it encrypted. Needs a recent sign-in and is alerted:
whoever holds the key's account can see what is sent to it.

post.description:
Check the stored key still works, and record the answer: a refused key is marked
failed, a working one clears an earlier failure, so the status matches the check.

schema.title: Response List Connections Api Account Connections Get

delete.description:
Revoke: its access and refresh tokens stop working at once. Like signing out a device,
it needs no fresh sign-in: it only ever takes access away.

post.description:
Erase everything stored about the signed-in person (ADR-0044): workouts, measurements,
photos, settings, passkeys and every signed-in browser. Needs a recent sign-in, like
passkey changes; signs this browser out and alerts on Telegram.

get.description:
Everything stored about the signed-in person, as a zip: data.json and the photos. Like a
passkey change it needs a recent sign-in, and it is alerted: it is everything at once.

put.description: Save the birth year and own max (either empty), and count recent zone minutes again.

post.description:
A new secret for the phone, replacing any earlier one. Needs a recent sign-in and is
alerted: whoever holds it can add health data.

delete.description: Remove a passkey; like adding one, it needs a recent sign-in (ADR-0040).

post.description:
Confirm it's you: this browser's session counts as a fresh sign-in for 10 minutes, so
a change that needs one goes through without signing out and in again.

Options to confirm it's still you with your fingerprint (ADR-0049); 409 without a
passkey (then only signing in again with a link makes the session fresh).
Options for adding a passkey to the signed-in person.
Options for signing in with a passkey; anyone may ask, only a registered key passes.

Exchange a one-time link from the bot for a session cookie. Once a passkey exists only
a recovery link does (403 otherwise: use the fingerprint, ADR-0040).
End this browser's session. Harmless without one.

schema.title: Response Offers Api Band Offers Get

post.description:
Count a band workout as cardio. 404 when it isn't on offer; 409 when today's session
changed in a way that makes it stale (count it again), or with what is saved already when
the day has its session (ADR-0060): count it again with the answer.

409.description: The day already has its session (a ClashView), or today changed

get.description: Every measurement, newest day first.

put.description: Save a day's measurements (any of them), replacing the same kind that day.

get.description: What can be measured, in order, with units and ranges.

schema.title: Response Kinds Api Body Kinds Get

post.description:
Save one cardio log for today. 409 when today's session changed meanwhile, or with
what is saved already when the day has its session (ADR-0060).

409.description: The day already has its session (a ClashView), or today changed

post.description: Approve: a connection with the scopes ticked, and the app's address with its code.
Bind a consent page to this browser, once its passkey is proved on the page.
Don't allow: back to the app with ``access_denied``. Public, like the details.

What a consent page asks for. Public: the handle is the secret, and nothing here is
personal.

put.description: Answer today's check; answering again the same day replaces the answers.

get.description: What was logged on ``on`` (default: today).

put.description: Tick or untick a habit for today. Repeating the same tap changes nothing.

get.description:
All-time totals, this week against the plan, ladder progress, the last seven days and
today's session.

post.description: Store a Health Connect Webhook payload for the person whose secret it carries.

Save what was done on a day. 409 with what is there when the day already has its
session; 422 with the reason when it can't be saved.

409.description: The day already has its session (a ClashView), or today changed

get.description: A session's exercises and targets, to enter what was done on ``day``.
Every photo, newest day first (no pictures, just what there is).

put.description: Store a photo for a day and pose, replacing one already there; its metadata is removed.

get.description: One photo. Never cached anywhere but in memory.
The training plan, for the signed-in owner: the site is private (no public pages).

Weekly fractional sets per muscle with its band and warnings, from the plan as it
stands; nothing here changes it.
Every exercise in plan order: its step, last session, best set and whether it's ready.
Each session that has been timed, in plan order: how long it usually takes.

schema.title: Response Times Api Progress Times Get

post.description: Discard it; nothing is saved. Discarding one already dealt with changes nothing.

Save it. 404 when it has expired or never was; 409 with ``already_saved`` or
``already_discarded`` when it was dealt with (here or in Telegram); 409 with the reason
when it no longer fits (it is discarded then); 409 with what is saved already when its
day has its session (it keeps waiting: save it again with the answer, ADR-0060).

409.description: The day already has its session (a ClashView), or today changed

put.description: Answer every question; the answers replace any earlier ones.

get.description: Earlier days' guided sessions with sets but never saved, to offer saving them.

schema.title: Response Pending Api Session Pending Get

put.description:
Keep where the person is in today's session, so it resumes on any device. 409 when
another device moved on since this browser's ``revision`` (reload and carry on).

post.description:
Save the guided session as a workout: today's, or an earlier day's left unsaved. 409
with what is saved already when that day has its session (ADR-0060).

409.description: The day already has its session (a ClashView), or today changed

get.description: The stretches after a saved resistance workout, filling ``minutes`` (ADR-0032).

post.description: Log the stretching minutes on the workout, once.

get.description:
Today's session in work order, with any pairs swapped as kept in the progress: a swap
or un-swap is a PUT to /progress, so the server is the one place it lives.
Every test, day 1 first.

post.description: Save a test day once (a repeated Save with the same token returns it).

get.description: The test day due today, if any (ADR-0038).

schema.title: Response Due Api Tests Due Get

get.description: Every test day, newest first.

schema.title: Response Results Api Tests Results Get

get.description: What Swap offers: the next session first, or any other one for today.

post.description: Do the next session today and the planned one tomorrow (ADR-0022).
Do another session today; the planned one is still next (ADR-0022).
Hold today's planned session for tomorrow; the rest of the week shifts a day.
Rest today: the optional rest session counts as done, any other waits a day.

get.description: The change Undo would take back: the last rest day, push, swap or saved log.

post.description:
Take back the change ``event_id`` names, if it is still the last one (ADR-0048).
409 when it isn't: a newer change, or something moved since.
One JSON-RPC message (MCP Streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON answers).

get.description:
The authorization request (OAuth 2.1, PKCE S256, RFC 8707). On to the consent page with
a handle (in the fragment, so no log or Referer sees it), or an error.

post.description:
Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591), bounded: registering grants nothing until the
person approves the app with their passkey.
The token endpoint, form-encoded (RFC 6749): a code for tokens, or a refresh.
